```php title="PHP"
<?php

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Xberg\Xberg;

$input = \Xberg\ExtractInput::from_json(json_encode(["bytes" => "text/plain.txt", "config" => [], "filename" => "plain.txt", "kind" => "bytes", "mimeType" => "not-a-mime"]));
```
